# Admin API operations

**For:** administrators and the tools they write. Every operation of the
administration API, client registration and the audit records, as the
OpenAPI document at `GET {issuer}/admin/openapi.json` describes them.
[The admin API](../configure/admin-api.md) explains each.

| Operation | What it does | Who may call it | Answers |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /admin/openapi.json` | This document. | anyone, without a token | `200` |
| `POST /register` | Registers a client (RFC 7591 §3). | an app registering itself, when registration is open; or a token of `system/admin` | `201`, `400`, `401`, `409`, `413`, `415` |
| `GET /register/{client_id}` | Reads a client's metadata (RFC 7592 §2.1). | the client's registration access token; or a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401` |
| `PUT /register/{client_id}` | Replaces a client's metadata (RFC 7592 §2.2). | the client's registration access token; or a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `400`, `401`, `404`, `409`, `413`, `415` |
| `DELETE /register/{client_id}` | Deprovisions a client, revoking every grant and token it holds (RFC 7592 §2.3). | the client's registration access token; or a token of `system/admin` | `204`, `401`, `404` |
| `GET /admin/clients` | Every registered client, disabled ones included. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403` |
| `POST /admin/clients/{client_id}/disable` | Disables a client: no request finds it again, and every grant and token it holds is revoked. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409` |
| `POST /admin/clients/{client_id}/enable` | Enables a disabled client. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403`, `404`, `409` |
| `GET /admin/keys` | The signing key ring: each public key with its state. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403` |
| `GET /audit` | FerroSMART's audit records, newest first, a page at a time. | a token of `system/AuditEvent.rs` | `200`, `400`, `401`, `403` |
| `GET /admin/upstreams` | The state of each upstream provider, in configuration order. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403` |
| `GET /admin/subjects` | A person's FerroSMART subject: the pairwise subject of their sub at a provider. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `400`, `401`, `403`, `404` |
| `GET /admin/subjects/{sub}/grants` | A person's live grants, newest first, and the consents they remembered. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403` |
| `DELETE /admin/subjects/{sub}/grants/{grant_id}` | Revokes one of the person's live grants with every token under it. | a token of `system/admin` | `204`, `401`, `403`, `404` |
| `DELETE /admin/subjects/{sub}/consents/{client_id}` | Disconnects the client from the person: their remembered consent is forgotten and the client's grants about them revoked (GDPR Art 7(3)). | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403` |
| `DELETE /admin/subjects/{sub}/sessions` | Ends every upstream session of the person with the online_access grants in it. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `401`, `403` |
| `POST /admin/clients/{client_id}/secret` | Issues a confidential symmetric client a new secret, answered once (RFC 7591 §3.2.1); the old secret no longer authenticates. | a token of `system/admin` | `200`, `400`, `401`, `403`, `404` |
